title: Admin - Change Vendor Status (Active ↔ Inactive) (20 Test Cases)
overview: Functional testing of SCRUM-484: Admin activates or deactivates vendors. Validates status dropdown, deactivation hides products, blocks new products, blocks replies, notifies users, reactivation restores access, status change logged, warning for active inquiries, error handling on failure.

testCases.title: Vendor Management Page is Accessible
Vendor List Displays Vendors with Status
Status Dropdown Available for Active Vendors
Status Dropdown Shows Active and Inactive Options
steps: Open status dropdown for a vendor.
Verify both Active and Inactive options present.

testCases.title: Changing Status to Inactive Triggers Confirmation
Confirming Deactivation Updates Vendor Status
steps: Verify vendor status changes to Inactive.

testCases.title: Deactivated Vendor Products Hidden from Catalog
steps: Verify vendor products no longer visible in catalog.

testCases.title: Deactivated Vendor Cannot Add New Products
steps: Verify vendor blocked from adding products.

testCases.title: Deactivated Vendor Cannot Reply to Queries/Comments
steps: Verify vendor blocked from replying to queries.

testCases.title: Users Notified About Vendor Deactivation
Reactivating Vendor Restores Active Status
Reactivated Vendor Products Visible Again
Status Change is Logged
steps: Verify activity/audit log records the change.

testCases.title: Warning Shown for Vendor with Active Inquiries
steps: Attempt to deactivate vendor with active inquiries.

testCases.title: Cancel Deactivation Keeps Vendor Active
Status Change Failure Reverts UI with Error
steps: Verify UI reverts and error message shown.

testCases.title: Status Persists After Page Refresh
Vendor Status Filter Works Correctly
Vendor Management Responsive on Mobile
Multiple Vendors Can Be Managed Sequentially
